metadata.title: Groupicorn Indiana IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. September 22, 2026 completed an Indianapolis second discovery pass: nine distinct provider groups are publication-ready with exact-site IOP/PHP evidence and local PNG assets, and Spark Recovery is additionally verified but logo-pending. Caring Associates is also verified but logo-pending because current official branding is unavailable and older public records conflict on the suite address. Indiana now includes a practical geography skeleton for Fort Wayne, Indianapolis, Northwest Indiana, South Bend/Mishawaka, Lafayette/West Lafayette, Bloomington, Evansville, Terre Haute, Muncie, and Clarksville/Southern Indiana. A parallel September 22 discovery pass added publication-ready groups in Fort Wayne, Lafayette/West Lafayette, Bloomington, Muncie, and Terre Haute; Evansville and Clarksville/Southern Indiana remain unpopulated research catchments rather than claims of no local programs.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset. Existing asset provenance and license clearance require separate review where source URLs are not yet recorded.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

research_queue.name: Indiana statewide discovery stack
research_queue.task: Complete normal web, local-business/Maps, Yelp, Reddit, Psychology Today, SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov, and major health-system/state/county directory searches; record dispositions for every meaningful lead.

research_queue.name: IU Health Addiction Treatment & Recovery Center - Indianapolis
research_queue.task: Published after verifying the exact adult IOP site at 1701 N. Senate Blvd. and acquiring the official IU Health horizontal logo. Do not infer PHP or primary mental-health eligibility from this addiction IOP record.

research_queue.name: Spark Recovery
research_queue.task: Official Spark Recovery pages verify 8005 Castleway Drive, Indianapolis, and adult PHP/IOP. Acquire and validate an official local PNG logo before shortlist inclusion; the current site did not expose a usable official logo asset during this pass.

research_queue.name: Evolve Indy-Addiction and Mental Health Center
research_queue.task: Published after the official Evolve Indy site confirmed the 8770 Guion Rd., Suite B address, adult PHP/IOP offerings, and current operating evidence; official logo saved locally.

research_queue.name: Indianapolis second-pass health-system and local leads
research_queue.task: Rechecked official and public leads: Franciscan Health Behavioral Health IOP is supported by an older Marion/Johnson County health-needs assessment at 5320 E. Stop 11 Rd but needs a current official program page and site confirmation; Ascension/St. Vincent searches yielded a general behavioral-health page but no current exact-site IOP/PHP page; Ethan Crossing's current Indiana DMHA and Joint Commission records identify 4102 Shore Dr., Indianapolis, for residential/subacute services, not a verified IOP/PHP offering, so it is excluded from the strict shortlist. Life Recovery Center was verified and published at 1440 N. Hudson; Evolve Indy and Hendricks Behavioral Hospital were verified and published. Maple Heights Behavioral Health has an Indianapolis adolescent IOP page marked Opening Soon and remains excluded from current shortlist publication.

research_queue.name: Hendricks Behavioral Hospital
research_queue.task: Published after the official Hendricks Behavioral Hospital page confirmed adult in-person IOP at its outpatient department, 1051 Southfield Drive, Plainfield; adolescent IOP evidence and the Joint Commission locator were used as corroboration. Official logo saved locally.

research_queue.name: Caring Associates Counseling Group
research_queue.task: Current Indiana DMHA records and Psychology Today identify an active outpatient provider with in-person adult/adolescent IOP at 37 Motif Blvd, Brownsburg, IN 46112. Assign to the Indianapolis editorial catchment. Do not publish until a current official provider page and official local logo are resolved; older public records cite a 23 Motif suite, so recheck the suite before publication.

research_queue.name: Community Fairbanks Recovery Center / Fairbanks
research_queue.task: Official Community Health Network and Joint Commission records support PHP/IOP or high-intensity outpatient at 8102 Clearvista Parkway. Keep this lead grouped with the existing Community Health Network provider rather than creating a duplicate provider group; verify whether a separate location record is needed in a later pass.

research_queue.name: Options Behavioral Health Hospital
research_queue.task: Exclude from publication: the provider's current official page states that the hospital has closed and is no longer accepting patients.

research_queue.name: Charlie Health
research_queue.task: Exclude from this physical-location shortlist: the Indianapolis page describes a virtual IOP and does not establish an Indianapolis treatment site.

research_queue.name: Indianapolis platform discovery leads
research_queue.task: Yelp was blocked by robots.txt, so no Yelp claims were used. Psychology Today leads included Evolve Indy, Avenues Recovery, Indy Teen Treatment Center, Hendricks Behavioral Hospital, Caring Associates, Firefly Children and Family Alliance, Indianapolis Comprehensive Treatment Center, Thrive Mental Health, Care to Change, and Resource Treatment Center: Avenues, Evolve Indy, Hendricks, and ITTC were verified and published; Caring Associates remains verified/logo-pending; Firefly and Care to Change showed general counseling rather than verified IOP/PHP; Indianapolis CTC is opioid MAT rather than strict IOP/PHP; Thrive was virtual-only; Resource Treatment Center described referrals rather than a current local IOP/PHP. Reddit surfaced IU Health, Community, and St. Vincent leads; IU Health is now published and Community is already represented. SAMHSA/Indiana public-directory searches produced address and level-of-care leads used only for corroboration.

research_queue.name: Northwest Indiana first-pass discovery
research_queue.task: Normal web and Indiana DMHA searches surfaced Brightside Rehab (Valparaiso), Spero Health Gary, Care Counseling Services (Valparaiso), Parkdale Center (Chesterton), Porter-Starke Services, Brighter Day Community Health Services, Community Change Center Recovery Connection, AD Rehab (Merrillville), and a Northwest Health Porter intensive-outpatient project. Brightside, Spero, Care Counseling, and Parkdale were verified against current provider pages and published; AD Rehab has strong current PHP/IOP/address evidence but remains queued for a clean official logo asset, while Porter-Starke and the other leads remain queued until an exact current IOP/PHP page and treatment address are confirmed. Yelp was blocked/no reliable program evidence was used; Reddit searches produced no verifiable exact-site program evidence; Psychology Today, SAMHSA/state directories, and health-system pages were used only as discovery or corroboration, not as standalone proof.

research_queue.name: South Bend / Mishawaka first-pass discovery
research_queue.task: Normal web, Indiana DMHA, Joint Commission, and provider-site searches surfaced Indiana Center for Recovery in Mishawaka, Oaklawn South Bend outpatient, Cardinal Recovery/Zinnia South Bend, Medical Behavioral Hospital Mishawaka, Dockside Services, Catholic Charities, and additional Oaklawn locations. Indiana Center for Recovery, Oaklawn, and Cardinal were verified against exact-site or accreditation records and published; Medical Behavioral Hospital, Dockside, and Catholic Charities remain queued pending stronger current exact-site IOP/PHP evidence. Yelp was blocked/no reliable program evidence was used; Reddit searches produced no verifiable exact-site program evidence; Psychology Today, SAMHSA/state directories, and health-system pages were used as discovery or corroboration only.

research_queue.name: Fort Wayne parallel discovery pass
research_queue.task: Official pages verified Avenues Recovery Center at Fort Wayne, Farrington Specialty Centers, and Maple Heights/Strive leads. Avenues and Farrington are published; Maple Heights has strong current IOP/address evidence but no usable local logo asset was acquired in this pass, and Strive remains a follow-up candidate.

research_queue.name: Lafayette / West Lafayette parallel discovery pass
research_queue.task: Official provider pages and documents verified Sycamore Springs, Franciscan outpatient behavioral health, and Meridian Health Services at physical Lafayette sites. All three are published; additional Purdue-area and eating-disorder leads remain for later review.

research_queue.name: Bloomington parallel discovery pass
research_queue.task: Official IU Health pages verified psychiatric and addiction IOP evidence at 727 W. 2nd St.; Centerstone's current location directory and Indiana public resource records support a South Rogers IOP lead. IU Health and Centerstone are published; Centerstone's current site-specific IOP schedule should be rechecked.

research_queue.name: Terre Haute parallel discovery pass
research_queue.task: The Joint Commission verified Anabranch's PHP/IOP sites; Next Step's official site verified PHP/IOP services and its Terre Haute foundation address; Griffin and Associates verified an IOP for teens and adults at its Ohio Boulevard office. All three provider groups are now published, with Anabranch's second site retained in source but deduplicated from the display shortlist.

research_queue.name: Muncie parallel discovery pass
research_queue.task: Centerstone's official Muncie location page verified IOP at 1200 S. Tillotson Overpass; Campus BHC's official site and current careers page support adult PHP/IOP at 808 W. White River Blvd. Both are published; additional Delaware County discovery remains warranted.
